name: Phanta
source:
Phanta is a timid, gentle, and shy ghost-girl. Despite being scared of most people, and most things, she tries to be kind and helpful to everyone. She has self-worth issues stemming from her [url=https://vndb.org/c153686]father[/url].

[In game description]
